body:
IDUNA_PRO commits 2765e1e/af423d1; IDUNA commit fae8f23; MONOREPO commit 14fa7e5. Founder real-time: 'we pull some of the more custom stuff out of iduna and the code goes right into the emily for business product IDUNA_PRO'. Extracted the real core candidates named in IDUNA/docs/EMILY_FOR_BUSINESS_NORTHSTAR.md's own categorization: internal/auth (Google OAuth, ES256 JWT hand-rolled on crypto/ecdsa, M2M agent auth, device flow), internal/store (SQLite+MySQL, migrations engine), internal/userlog (unified Splunk-shaped logging backend + local-user event log/projector), internal/util, internal/http/middleware, plus the core handlers (Google/local/agent/device auth, JWT refresh, self-serve registration, /me, users, agents, Apples audit ledger, unified log ingest/search). Checked directly BEFORE copying: zero cross-imports from any of these into IDUNA's own custom packages (blog/tyler/promptoverse/mailinglist/vault/drive/statuspage/backlog) -- the categorization held under an actual extraction, not just inspection. New standalone go.mod (module idunapro, GOWORK=off), new main.go, 7 core migration files (device_auth, iam_rbac, agent_credentials, apples, local_users, missing_agents_table_rows, agent_pending_status) -- EINHORN-specific system_seeds.sql and cluster_heartbeats.sql deliberately excluded. go build/vet/test ./... clean. Live-verified, not just compiled: booted the real binary against a fresh SQLite file, migrations created exactly the expected core tables and none of the excluded ones; confirmed /health, a real ES256 key from /.well-known/jwks.json, a real self-serve POST /api/v1/auth/register issuing a real JWT, and POST /api/v1/auth/local correctly rejecting bad credentials. Real, honest, found gap, not fixed here: GET /api/v1/identities/me calls store.GetUserByID, which only resolves Google-OAuth-style UUID ids -- a local-auth JWT's subject (local:<N>) doesn't resolve, so a self-serve-registered user gets 404 from /me today. Confirmed this is a pre-existing gap inherited from IDUNA's own GetUserByID implementation, not introduced by the extraction, but named because it matters more for a self-serve-auth-first product. Also wrote a real, phased extensibility plan (not built): customer-side PARENA mods compiled via BURROW's native Go emission target (burrow build, not PARENA's own C target parena-c uses -- IDUNA_PRO's host is Go, the same real reason DUNG needs the Go target too, zero cgo/FFI boundary), with JEWEL named as a real, already-existing precedent for an eventual online editor that needs real adaptation (different execution model for the Go target vs JEWEL's own C-target compile-and-run flow), not a direct reuse.

⚓ ☃
title: IDUNA_PRO v0 -- real, extracted, standalone core IAM service, live-verified
